Descriptions marked source 'uber' are the restaurant's own wording, lifted from its Uber Eats/Postmates storefront and then extended; 'standard' entries describe a standard preparation of a well-known item and claim nothing specific to this kitchen. Review before re-running.

breads-plain-naan.text: Classic leavened white-flour flatbread, hand-stretched and slapped against the wall of the tandoor until it puffs and blisters. The house bread for scooping up curry.

breads-coconut-naan.text: Soft, lightly sweetened flatbread infused with coconut, baked fresh in the tandoor. Good against a rich, spiced curry.

breads-herbal-naan.text: Freshly baked Indian-style flatbread infused with herbs, finished in the tandoor. Aromatic enough to eat on its own.

breads-rosemary-naan.text: Freshly baked naan infused with the aromatic flavor of rosemary — a house twist on the tandoor classic.

breads-plain-paratha.text: Soft, unleavened flatbread, layered and griddled with butter until it separates into flaky sheets.

breads-paneer-paratha.text: Indian-style flatbread filled with crumbled paneer, griddled until golden and flaky.

breads-onion-paratha.text: Traditional Indian flatbread stuffed with spiced onions, griddled until the edges crisp.

breads-aalo-paratha.text: Traditional Indian flatbread stuffed with spiced potatoes, griddled until golden — a Himalayan breakfast staple.

breads-coconut-paratha.text: Flaky, coconut-infused flatbread — layered, lightly sweet, and griddled to a crisp edge.

side-order-basmati-rice.text: Long-grain basmati, steamed loose and fluffy. The default base for any curry on the menu.

side-order-brown-rice.text: Steamed whole-grain brown rice — nuttier and chewier than basmati, and a whole-grain swap under any curry.

side-order-raita.text: Cooling whipped yogurt with cucumber and gentle spice — the standard foil to anything hot off the tandoor.

side-order-mango-chutney.text: Sweet and tangy condiment made with mango. Good alongside curry, or with samosa and pakora.

side-order-mixed-pickle.text: A blend of tangy and sweet pickled vegetables in oil and spice — sharp and salty, meant in small spoonfuls.

beverages-tea-chai.text: Black tea simmered with milk, cardamom, ginger and warm spice. Served hot.

beverages-mango-lassi.text: Alphonso mango blended with yogurt into a thick, cold, gently sweet drink — the classic cooler for a spicy meal.

beverages-plainsaltsweet-lassi.text: Churned yogurt served the way you like it: plain, salted, or sweet. Cold, thick, and traditional.

beverages-iced-tea.text: Fresh-brewed black tea over ice, unsweetened.

beverages-soda-coke-diet-coke-sprite.text: Chilled canned soda. Choice of Coke, Diet Coke, or Sprite.
